verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to a live Editor session, letting them modify project data and verify results, plus 'PlayCanvas Skills' giving AI coding agents project-specific workflows — real evidence of natural-language/agentic operation. However, this is scoped to editor manipulation via an agent client rather than a general natural-language command interface across the whole product, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: independent verification of the MCP server's real-world reliability, evidence of natural-language control over broader product surfaces (e.g. account/project management, publishing) beyond the Editor scene, and any hands-on community reports of AI-native usage.
